UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Private cloud-synchronized learning progression for an authenticated Cyberland user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this progression record.

learnerName.description: Learner display name chosen in Cyberland.

completedIslands.description: Bounded list of completed island IDs (max 35).

totalXp.description: Total XP accumulated across islands, quizzes, debug tickets, and labs.

bestExamScore.description: Best mock exam score out of 20 (or -1 if none).

neutralizedAttacksCount.description: Count of distinct real-time attacks neutralized.

bestSpeedrunMs.description: Fastest completed Speedrun time in milliseconds (0 if none).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public, PII-free Cyberland leaderboard entry for XP and Speedrun rankings.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public learner pseudonym (no email or PII).

bestSpeedrunMs.description: Best Speedrun completion time in milliseconds (0 if not set).

bestSpeedrunCircuit.description: Label of the circuit for the best Speedrun time.

rankTitle.description: Highest unlocked Cyberland expertise badge title.

isPublic.description: Explicit opt-in flag allowing listing on the online leaderboard.

UserRole.title: UserRole
UserRole.description: Admin-managed RBAC role assignment enforced at the Firestore database layer.

userId.description: Target Firebase UID whose role is controlled.

assignedBy.description: Verified admin UID who granted or modified the role.

note.description: Optional justification note for the role assignment.

ProtectedAdminVault.title: ProtectedAdminVault
ProtectedAdminVault.description: Admin-only protected configuration document (grading policies & exam governance) strictly enforced by Firestore rules.

policyName.description: Human-readable name of the protected administrative policy.

minPassingScore.description: Minimum passing score out of 20 for official certification.

requireSignedTransfers.description: Whether HMAC-SHA256 server-signed transfer codes are required.

strictZeroTrustMode.description: Whether strict backend + database authorization enforcement is active.

updatedBy.description: Verified admin UID who last updated the vault document.

actorUid.description: Verified admin UID who executed the audited action.

outcome.description: Decision outcome recorded in the audit log.

/user_progress/{userId}.description: Owner-only (plus admin audit read) cloud progress sync for authenticated learners.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: PII-free online XP and Speedrun leaderboard entries.

/roles/{userId}.description: Database-enforced RBAC role assignments writable exclusively by verified Admins.

/protected_admin_vault/{docId}.description: Admin-only protected configuration vault proving database-side authorization.

/security_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Append-only immutable administrative security audit records.
